captions.detailed: A realistic bell tower featuring a sturdy brown wooden frame mounted on a gray concrete pedestal base. The tower is topped with a dark sloped roof and a decorative black finial. Suspended from an internal crossbar is a golden-bronze bell that swings naturally from its mount.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of an architectural bell tower with a solid concrete base, a square wooden support frame, a sloped roof with a top finial, and a realistic bronze bell that can swing realistically.
captions.factory: Construct the bell tower starting with a rectangular box for the concrete base. Build the wooden support frame using four corner columns and horizontal crossbeams. Model the roof as a pyramid or sloped box, topped with a cylindrical finial. Create the bell using a revolved profile or combined cylinders and cones, and mount it to the internal crossbar using a revolute joint to enable swinging motion.
